title: THE POUNCE THAT WAS PROMISED // AZOR A-CAT
narrative: Tommen's black-and-tan kitten steps onto the Iron Throne. His whiskers twitch with ancient Valyrian fire. He plunges his tiny claw into a bowl of cream, drawing forth Lightbringer—a glowing three-inch flaming needle of celestial heat. "Meow," whispers the Prince That Was Promised. The Great Other trembles in the frozen north as Ser Pounce bats a burning ball of yarn across the Red Keep floors.

options.text: Duel the Night King on the battlements using extreme zoomies.
Form an alliance with Hot Pie's divine sourdough bakery.
Claim the Iron Throne as feline sovereign of the Seven Kingdoms.
